Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: A Champion in Court
Cards.Text:
As a Focus Effect: You may substitute one of your Yojimbo Personalities for your Personality in this duel.
Reaction: After another player's action destroys one of your Courtier or Shugenja Personalities, choose your performing Yojimbo Personality: Give him three +1F Revenge tokens.

Cards.Name: Brothers in Battle
Cards.Text: Battle/Open: Choose two or three of your performing Samurai: Each of them has +1F and the ability, "Battle: Ranged 4 Attack" while in an army with one or more of the others.

Cards.Name: Honest Assessment
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Samurai and target an enemy Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor: Bow him. Gain 1 Honor, or 3 Honor if your Family Honor is 9 or less.

Cards.Name: Killing Intent
Cards.Text:
As a Focus Effect: You may choose (now) to use the base Force of your Personality in this duel as his duel stat if he is at a battlefield.
Battle: Choose your performing Personality: Straighten him. You may move him home.

Cards.Name: Spirit of the Shadows
Cards.Text: Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: If he is a Ninja, permanently give him the ability, "Ninja Battle: Target two Personalities controlled by the same player at different locations: Switch their locations." Otherwise, permanently give him Ninja.

Cards.Name: Surrounded!
Cards.Text: Reaction: After engaging, choose your performing unbowed Scout at the current battlefield: You have Reconnaissance there. Ranged Attacks from your card effects during this battle have +2 strength.

Cards.Name: Turning Away
Cards.Text:
As a Focus Effect: You may discard your Personality in this duel (ending the duel without resolution).
Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield, choose your performing Monk at any location and bow your target Ring: Give the current battlefield's province +3 or -3 strength.
